integrity: Proof and explicitly bounded asymptotic given; finite exhaustive checker supports but does not replace general proof. No independent audit or authorship certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only split dual-number rings in characteristic two, fixed finite q in the asymptotic; no statement for characteristic-four Witt rings. The full text of two relevant historical canonical-form papers was inaccessible and priority is not independently certified.
title: Uniform reduction-rank law for involutions over characteristic-two finite dual numbers
